observations.title: Reorder server or resource-pack entries
observations.player_action: Drag an entry in a supported server/resource-pack list.
observations.outcome: Entries can be moved directly instead of repeatedly pressing move buttons.
conditions: The reviewed original page describes Fabric; the installed Forge artifact's port-specific screens require separate source confirmation.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
